description: agent inside an ad-hoc sub-process for a loan investigation, choosing which assessment / verification step runs next and producing a recommendation

product-content enrichment: three parallel AI tasks derive highlights, derive keywords and summarise a description; results are saved, then machine-translated into two languages, then released by a human and activated

product release: on product creation, an automatic categorisation service task and a DeepL machine-translation service task run in parallel with a human marketing task; after a data-quality gateway the product is activated, a datasheet generated and the product synced to the online shop

ticket handling: after a support agent creates a ticket, AI tasks classify it, prioritise it and produce a preliminary analysis for a human analyst; after the analyst's analysis and resolution, an AI task updates the knowledge base

expense reporting: an employee uploads receipt files, then an AI Worker bound to the employee's submit task extracts the details and pre-fills the form fields; the submitted report goes through a human analyst policy review and an optional manager approval before notification

customer onboarding / identity check: an automated identity-verification task (AI per page prose: compares submitted identity documents against official databases) precedes a gateway that routes to standard or enhanced due diligence; background check and data integration follow automatically, with a human review loop and a human approval before account creation

song requests for an event: an invited person submits a song via a web form; an AI task judges whether it fits the event type (yes / no / maybe) and the gateway routes to an acceptance or rejection notification, or on 'maybe' to a lyrics lookup and human review

message delivery agent: a script task builds the prompt, an AI agent task decides whether tools are needed and the ad-hoc tool sub-process runs its choice (Slack message, email, or a human 'get more info' task), looping back to the agent until no more tools are needed
claim adjuster flow: an AI task drafts a short email to the adjuster from policyholder details, which an email service task then sends; a Slack notification runs in parallel

customer inquiry routing: a customer enters an inquiry, an AI task determines the department (other / sales / technical / legal), a gateway routes it to the matching team's work task; the team can resolve, send it back through the AI with feedback, or reroute to a different team

loan application: after rule-based risk scoring and a KYC sub-process, an AI routing task assigns low / medium / high risk; low and high branches run automatically (accept or reject email plus issue-policy or reject-application service task), the medium branch has a second AI task summarise the results for a human investigator, whose risk assessment then routes to the low or high branch; a collapsed sentiment-analysis sub-process follows on both outcomes

tax-submission fraud check: an AI task rates fraud likelihood, a script task turns that into the tasks to run, and an ad-hoc sub-process runs the selected ones (AI-generated email inquiry then send email, a human 'call on external advisor' task with a fraud-detected gateway, a throw-fraud path); a second AI task re-rates fraud likelihood and a 'decision made?' gateway either ends the process or loops back to the first AI task; a fraud escalation ends the process separately

lost-baggage claim: a passenger report starts an AI agent (ad-hoc sub-process captioned 'leverages any LLM to decide the next best action') that picks among querying a baggage tracking database, messaging the last known airport, sending a care-products voucher, asking the passenger for more information, and organising baggage delivery then informing the passenger; afterwards a 'compensation claim?' gateway routes to a human 'process compensation' task or ends; 'low confidence' and a 48h timer on the agent route to a human 'manual processing' task

vendor application evaluation: AI extracts application data, a rule table screens products, humans review; AI writes a website description or a rejection email, sent automatically on rule-based rejection
insurance claim adjuster flow: an AI task composes an email telling the adjuster a claimant awaits an estimate, sent automatically, before the adjuster's estimate task
Invoice dispute: after a rejected invoice and sender notification, an AI agent looks up account details, contacts a sales rep, cancels or recreates the invoice, and shows findings to a clerk.

claim handling: an AI agent asks the insurer for missing information, consolidates the claim and evaluates it against policy rules; documentation and an insurer notification follow, with an escalation path to a human.
flight disruption rebooking: an AI agent queries external flight and hotel MCP servers, then requests a rebooking commit that a human must approve before a travel summary is returned
financial risk check: DMN risk rules run on submitted financial details, an AI task summarises the results, and medium-risk cases show the summary to a human investigator who decides accept or reject
loan AI agent whose tools are emailing the customer and awaiting a reply, a rule check, asking a loan specialist, querying a knowledge base, and an RPA object/QR-code/email sequence
Customer-support email: an AI agent on past conversations picks tools to reply to the customer, query the knowledge base, calculate loan repayment or ask a human expert, then saves the conversation.

insurance upsell: an AI agent task loops over a tool sub-process to consult an expert, call the policy holder, check rules, email recommendations, generate an umbrella offer email and trigger policy underwriting
Mortgage chat: a broker agent calls two remote A2A agents, rule-based risk scores, a conversation store and CRM lookups; a judge agent's confidence ends the chat or routes to a manual process.
Travel upsell: on a customer booking, an AI task enriches context, then an AI agent analyses the trip, checks risk, generates an offer that is sent after a rule check and activated on acceptance.
KYC screening: an AI agent picks sanctions, identity, risk-score and n8n-MCP address/employment checks, may ask a human for more information, then submits a screening result or escalates.
Call-quality audit: an AI agent analyses a recorded call transcript and drives an ad-hoc sub-process of AI report and email drafting, a human review and an email notification to the agent.
Customer-support email: an AI agent with past conversations emails the customer, queries the knowledge base or hands to a specialist; an AI judge then routes to auto-reply or human handling.
Retail return: AI fraud check gates eligibility, AI visual inspection results are pushed to systems, then an AI-driven ad-hoc sub-process picks exchange, refund, cleaning or refurbish fragments.
customer inquiry routing: an OpenAI task classifies the inquiry (or team feedback on retry) into a department label that a gateway uses to pick the handling team
Meeting scheduling: after a client email arrives and upcoming meetings are listed, an AI agent task picks the best time, and a Zoom meeting is created automatically.
Logistics order from inbound email: three agents in sequence extract and check order data, plan the shipment with the customer, then book it with the carrier and update the ERP.
Ticket support: an OpenAI task summarises a new ticket, then an AI agent picks tools to question engineers, search the knowledge base, summarise and post a solution comment.
Procure-to-pay intake: an AI task classifies the submitted purchase request after tenant configuration is loaded, before the approval stage.
Supplier invoice processing: document extraction feeds ERP posting, then an AI three-way match whose result, via a tolerance rule, auto-approves, escalates, disputes or rejects.
Out-of-spec lot handling: AI parses a physician email, then decides the disposition that selects conversion, discard, recollection, logging or escalation activities and downstream system updates.
customer inquiry routing: an Azure OpenAI task classifies the inquiry (or team feedback on retry) into a department label that a gateway uses to pick the handling team
Motor claim fast-track: an AI-enhanced validation scores the claim; confidence >= 0.85 auto-approves it and it flows on to settlement, payment and customer notification.
multi-channel customer messaging: an agent detects the customer's intent, forwards the message to business agents and replies to the customer on a chosen channel

Security incident triage: LLM calls generate a simulated alert, plan which investigation tools an ad-hoc sub-process runs, classify the threat and GDPR relevance, and write report texts for human review.
Generic chat: an AI agent answers a user's request by choosing MCP tools (memory, filesystem, remote wiki, time) and a script tool, looping on user feedback until satisfied.
Leave request: an AI agent checks the time-off balance or requests a doctor's note, then either approves automatically or escalates to supervisor and manager review.
Tax fraud check: an LLM picks which ad-hoc activities run (email inquiry, human advisor, fraud flag), an LLM drafts the inquiry email, and a second LLM check accepts the result or loops back.
AI reads data from an inbound invoice; a rule-based 3-way match checks it, then a human approves before ERP posting and archiving.
AI agent extracts data from a received supplier quote; approval rules then route to automatic approval or human approval before the order is placed and sent to the ERP.
AI agent reads details from receipts an employee uploaded via form; a payroll human reviews before payout or notifying the employee.
client onboarding: an AI agent checks the client's entered data and rates risk before automated document creation, lawyer review, client signature and filing
Inbound customer inquiry is classified and data points extracted by two AI agent tasks; a clerk checks the data before backend processing or a request to the customer.
complaint intake: an AI task categorises, prioritises and extracts data from an emailed or form-submitted complaint before automated system processing and a notification.
Supplier onboarding: an AI agent checks a registering supplier's data, documents and certificates (alternative to manual review) before automated CRM creation and buyer notification.
quote preparation: an AI agent classifies an emailed or web-form customer request and extracts requested items and quantities; humans confirm before the quote is generated and sent.
event registration: for an unknown company, an AI agent task checks the registrant's company data; valid data is created in the CRM and the participant registered automatically.
contract approval: an AI agent checks a submitted document before two reviewers and management sign digitally; then automated filing and audit log.
AI agent checks a submitted controlled document and extracts its data before human review and approval.
AI detects the intents of an inbound customer email; an inclusive gateway routes each intent to an AI extraction of structured data into process variables.
Inbound customer email: AI recognises intent, scores sentiment and extracts intent-specific data; results route to automatic processing or human handling.
LLM labels a case for fraud likelihood to drive an inclusive gateway; on the email label a second LLM drafts an information request sent automatically.
Lost-luggage agent: an AI-driven ad-hoc sub-process selects lookup, voucher, rebooking and delivery tools, or escalates / declares the bag lost.
Lost-baggage recovery: an LLM-controlled ad-hoc sub-process (Control Mode AI) locates the bag, rebooks it, arranges delivery, issues vouchers or declares it lost.
Tax-fraud screening: AI labels taxpayer data to route an inclusive gateway; on the email branch a second AI drafts a clarification email sent to the taxpayer automatically.
Invoice exception handling: AI verifies the invoice and routes to auto-accept, reject or human review, then AI drafts a rejection or exception brief.
invoice exception handling: an AI task verifies the case and sets the route; AI tasks write a rejection brief or an exception brief for human review.
AI classifies an HTTP-submitted support ticket; a gateway routes on its category to raising an issue or request, notifying a lead, or alerting support.
Gen AI task drafts an offer letter from candidate, position, salary and bonus variables; the letter is later sent to the candidate after interviews.
Gen AI task summarises the submitted claim documents after data validation, ahead of a DMN complexity decision.
Langflow-backed agent task researches and investigates complex claims before settlement calculation.
Credit card intake: an AI rule engine evaluates applications from web, mobile, chatbot and email channels and routes them to bot processing.
AI classifies an incoming support ticket; a rule table routes it to a human or to an agent that uses lookup, search and drafting tools before an automated reply is sent.
support triage: an AI task classifies the customer request and sets the route; on the simple path an AI task drafts the reply, which is sent automatically.
invoice pipeline: an AI task classifies the extracted, validated invoice as valid or invalid; valid ones are approved and recorded automatically.
LLM scans a patient's journal entry against a high-risk word list for suicidal ideation; its detection feeds triage rules that route to self-help, specialist or ER.
An AI performer on a user task scores the quality of an input appraisal; the score routes to approval/rejection directly or via a decision table to human review.
Agents validate a new CRM contact, research the company and summarise the contact in parallel, then score the lead; gateways route to opportunity creation or nurturing.
Agent resolves invoice-to-order mismatches; its resolved/rejected decision routes to human approval or to an automated rejection email to the supplier.
Agent compares retrieved invoice against purchase order (2-way matching); full match updates financial systems automatically, discrepancies go to manual review.
After a rejected invoice is emailed to the vendor, an agent investigates and resolves the vendor's dispute before the invoice returns to human approval.
An agent reads the latest inbox email, categorises it into a mail folder and moves it there.
An agent describes each attachment of the newest email in a mail folder, using an LLM file-analysis tool.
An agent turns a meeting transcript into minutes, decisions, risks and action items, which are automatically created as tracker tickets.
An agent validates a claim against policy terms and limits; its verdict denies the claim or sends it on to the assessments.
An agent scores fraud risk; high risk routes the claim to an investigator, low or medium goes straight to the officer review.
An agent estimates the claim payout for the officer's final decision.
An agent checks whether reinsurance treaty thresholds apply, for the officer's final decision.
An agent validates medical coding before submission; valid claims go automatically to the clearinghouse and the payer, invalid ones go to coder correction.
An agent checks the claim's attachments, clinical notes and required fields; complete claims go on to automatic submission, missing data raises an error to staff.
After a payer denial, an agent parses the rejection reason and puts the claim on a staff worklist.
An agent validates the policy behind a reported loss; an inactive policy rejects the claim, an active one starts the parallel evaluations.
An agent validates coverage of the reported loss; an excluded peril rejects the claim.
An agent screens the loss notice for fraud; a suspicion routes the claim to an investigator, otherwise it goes to adjuster assignment.
An agent enriches the loss intake data ahead of adjuster assignment and claim record creation.
When no preferred slot is free, an agent offers the patient alternatives or adds them to a waitlist; an accepted alternative is booked and confirmed.
An agent verifies insurance eligibility; ineligible requests are cancelled, eligible ones get an automatic confirmation.
